title: Mosslight Bastion
short_description: 100 woodland defenses. Four towers. Keep the mosslight burning.
long_description:
A small keep. A winding woodland lane. One lantern you refuse to let go dark.

Mosslight Bastion is a compact tower defense game about reading a route and making a little budget go a long way. Tap a glowing build pad, choose a guardian, and prepare before the next timed wave arrives. Start sooner with Send now, or let the countdown handle it.

HOLD THE LANE
Play 100 authored missions across twenty woodland regions, from Fernwake Glen to The Last Green Light. Every mission has five to ten waves and a final boss: a slow armored goliath, a sprinting skeletal hare or a broodroot that splits into sporelings. Visible fixed routes and clear build pads let you plan before the first visitor arrives. Upgrade a useful position, sell a misplaced tower, or save supplies for the next wave.

FOUR TOWERS, A THOUSAND DECISIONS
Archer fires quick, economical shots. Ember catches crowded sporelings with splash damage. Frost slows most foes. Prism reaches far and ignores armor. Twelve animated woodland enemy roles include fast runners, armored shellguards, slow-proof wisps, fluttering moths, splitting oozes and siege brambles, each asking for a different answer.

GROW A LITTLE BASTION INTO A HOME WORTH DEFENDING
Earn keeper XP, campaign stars and coins through ordinary play. Build permanent preparation upgrades, choose a lantern color, collect a seven-day login gift and complete daily action quests. Keep playing an expanding endless siege or a date-seeded daily defense; preparation upgrades are disabled in the daily mode.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
Pause freely, use free Rally and retry without paying. Waves advance on route-aware timers; you can start a cleared wave sooner without waiting for the countdown. The complete game loop works offline. Progress is stored on this device with a previous-valid backup. Unfinished combat is not saved across process death.

OPTIONAL ONLINE FEATURES
Android advertising is optional to ordinary play. An available earned native repair can restore up to eight keep hearts and 40 supplies once per run. Genuinely earned repair runs keep ordinary rewards and qualify for the same campaign stars and competitive records. Fullscreen ads leave combat paused until you choose Resume. No reward is invented when an ad is unavailable.

This local test edition uses official Google test ad IDs. Production Play Games achievements and leaderboards require owner configuration. Twenty local achievements and four local record categories remain available without sign-in.
monetization: Free ordinary progression and retries. Home/Results bottom banner; interstitial at natural transition after every 2 completed rounds; optional once/run earned repair. No in-app purchases implemented.
content_rating_notes: Stylized fantasy tower combat, no graphic injury. Intended general audience; owner must complete actual rating and audience declarations.
release_status: Local development package. Not a Google Play publication or eligibility declaration.
